options.description: THE MAW: A low, immensely broad dark plum-black Yeti with almost no visible forehead; its face is an oversized crescent-open mouth filled with four huge irregular ivory fangs and a black throat, plus two tiny hot amber eyes above it. Heavy crooked gorilla forearms, one long black claw on each hand, ragged haunches, short sturdy legs, pointed ear tufts. A grotesquely hungry organic alpine ape, not a skull or demon with horns. Face and mouth take up almost one third of the total body, clear ivory crescent contrast against near-black fur. Readable weighty triangular silhouette.
options.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Edit target: the steel-blue Yeti in row 2 column 1 of the attached transparent Frostline monster sprite sheet. Redesign that character into the specified distinctive voracious boss below. Output ONLY the redesigned single full-body monster sprite on genuine transparent alpha, no other cells or creatures. This is a tiny game sprite, not concept illustration. Preserve the slightly elevated front three-quarter camera, facing down/right toward the viewer. Essential style invariant: construct the complete monster on a COARSE logical 30 by 34 pixel grid, enlarged using exact nearest-neighbor square blocks. A whole fingertip or eye is one logical pixel. At most 14 palette colors, hard dark outlines, chunky hand-placed pixel clusters, no fine subpixel detail, no antialiasing, no gradients, no painted fur strands, no lighting bloom. It must be readable when shrunk to a 30x34 in-game sprite. Keep the full silhouette, feet, horns and claws inside that 30x34 logical box. Character occupies the central 70% of the transparent image, generous empty margins. ONE stalking/charging pose with planted feet and threatening forward hunch, shoulders and arms readable; no ground, shadow, lettering, labels, frame or scenery. Scary and ravenous, no gore, no cute teddy proportions, no clothes, no weapons, no robot/armor shapes.

options.description: BONECROWN: A tall gaunt ash-white and frost-grey Yeti with an exposed-looking pale bone MASK-LIKE FACE that is organic, deep pitch-black eye sockets and two red pinprick eyes, a wide split-tooth snarl, and TWO striking irregular dark ibex-like horns sweeping outward then backward above the brow. Lean black-shadowed torso, extremely long grey sinewy forearms with two ivory hook claws, bent narrow legs, jagged white shoulder tufts. Feral alpine nightmare, hunched and predatory, not a friendly goat or a robed skeleton. Horned V silhouette clearly different from broad gorilla. Bone-white head and crown contrast with charcoal limbs.

options.description: RUSTHOWL: A frantic rust-red shaggy Yeti with FOUR visible muscular arms and TWO bent hind legs (six limbs total), a compact snarling black ape head tucked between sharp red shoulder tufts, two sulfur-yellow eyes and short bone fangs. The main long arms reach down and outward as it skitters on its knuckles; the smaller second arm pair is raised slightly beside its ribcage with hooked bone-white claws. Deep brick-red fur lit with burnt-orange pixel clusters, black forearms and feet. Unhinged predatory simian movement, not an insect, not an octopus, no horns. Clear six-limbed sprawling silhouette and dark red palette make it unmistakably a different monster.
